facts.fact: THE REPOSITORY HAS AN ESTABLISHED CAPABILITY-GATED TEST-SKIP IDIOM, AND IT IS THE EXACT SHAPE THAT WOULD MAKE AN N05 TEST PASS VACUOUSLY.
facts.method: git grep for describe.skipIf across tests/ returned many call sites gated on a LIVE capability flag, for example in tests/authenticated-database-context.test.ts and tests/database-default-privileges.test.ts.

That is a feature, not an obstacle: it yields the derived obligation that the N05 demonstration must run with its working directory OUTSIDE the repository working tree, and it yields a positive control proving the scanner fires on the sentinel.

READINESS_CONTRACT.rule: This is the minimum contract. Each item states WHAT MUST BE PROVEN, the STANDARD OF PROOF, and WHAT DOES NOT COUNT AS PROOF. The third field is the load-bearing one: every condition below has a plausible cheap demonstration that proves nothing, and naming it is how a certifier can tell a discharge from a gesture. An item that cannot be discharged fires STOP_SECRET_DELIVERY_NONCOMPLIANT, which is the token the DAG already places at N05. NO NEW FAIL-CLOSED TOKEN IS CREATED BY THIS ARTIFACT.
universal_preconditions: THE DEMONSTRATION RUNS ON A NON-SECRET SENTINEL ONLY. No real credential enters any step of it, at any point, on any path. This is not a preference; WHAT_N05_MUST_PRODUCE states it as the manner of the demonstration.

THE DEMONSTRATION RUNS BEFORE MR-2. N05 is hoisted precisely so the proof precedes the irreversible mint. A demonstration performed after N11 has not discharged N05; it has documented a fait accompli.

THE DEMONSTRATION'S WORKING DIRECTORY IS OUTSIDE THE REPOSITORY WORKING TREE, per ES-5, so that neither a sentinel nor a transcript can land in the tree, inflate ods:scope or redden the untracked arm.
THE MECHANISM IS NAMED BY WHAT IT DOES. A product name alone does not discharge WHAT_N05_MUST_PRODUCE's first item, which requires the mechanism to be described by its behaviour.

items.must_be_proven: A single, named mechanism exists, and the demonstration describes: what reads the custody store; what process receives the value; under exactly which environment-variable name; and whether the reader lives inside or outside the repository tree.
items.standard_of_proof: A description from which an independent reader could identify the same mechanism again, and could tell whether a second demonstration used the same one.
items.what_does_NOT_count: A product name alone. A class name such as an OS credential vault. A description of the CUSTODY STORE, which OD-2 already selected, offered in place of a description of the READER, which OD-2 did not select.

items.must_be_proven: The variable is present in the environment of the single consuming command, and DOES NOT PERSIST TO A NEW SHELL.
items.standard_of_proof: TWO observations, not one. First, the value is observed present inside the consuming process, by the consumer's own successful resolution of it and not by printing it. Second, AFTER the demonstration, a FRESHLY LAUNCHED shell, started from the ordinary user session and not from the demonstration's process tree, is checked for the variable name and reports it ABSENT. The second observation is what the condition actually asserts.
items.what_does_NOT_count: Reading the setting code and concluding it is process-scoped. Checking the same shell that ran the demonstration, which cannot distinguish process scope from session scope. Checking the persistent user environment store while the originating session is still open, which can be stale in either direction.

items.must_be_proven: The value is READ from the secret store INTO the process environment, and at no point is it carried as a command-line argument by any process in the demonstration.
items.standard_of_proof: The command line of EVERY process in the demonstration's process tree is observed FROM OUTSIDE those processes, while they are running, and none contains the sentinel. The observation must cover the process that performs the vault read, the process that sets the environment, and the consuming process, even where those are the same process.
items.what_does_NOT_count: A process inspecting and reporting its OWN command line, which is a self-report by the party under examination. An assertion that the mechanism does not use arguments, unaccompanied by an external observation. Inspecting only the consuming process, which is the one least likely to carry the value and the one whose innocence was never in doubt.
items.derived_note: This item also reaches the CUSTODY DEPOSIT question at OF-N05-2. A vault-write performed by a command carrying the value as an argument would re-introduce exactly the disclosure WCM-C2 exists to prevent, one step earlier in the chain and outside any node of the DAG.

items.must_be_proven: Shell history is disabled for the session, OR the session is a fresh non-persisting one.
items.standard_of_proof: TWO parts. First, the demonstration ENUMERATES BY NAME every history-persisting facility of the session it runs in, and states for each whether it is disabled or non-persisting. Second, AFTER the run, every enumerated history sink is searched for the sentinel and each search returns no match.
items.what_does_NOT_count: A blanket statement that history is off, without enumerating what was checked. Enumerating the interactive command history while omitting a separately-configured line-editor history file, or a terminal-application scrollback that persists independently of the shell. Asserting a fresh session without stating what makes it non-persisting.
items.STRUCTURAL_NOTE: WCM-C3 IS A PROPERTY OF THE SESSION, NOT OF THE MECHANISM. Unlike WCM-C1, C2, C4 and C5, no mechanism can satisfy it intrinsically: the same mechanism invoked from a history-persisting session fails it and from a fresh session passes it. N05 asks for a demonstration that THE MECHANISM satisfies all five conditions, which for C3 can only mean that the mechanism carries an INVOCATION CONTRACT that imposes the session property, and that the contract is ENFORCED rather than documented. The readiness contract therefore requires the demonstration to state HOW the session property is enforced at every future invocation, not merely that it held once. Flagged OF-N05-3.

items.must_be_proven: The value is removed IMMEDIATELY after the consuming process exits, on BOTH the success path and the failure path.
items.standard_of_proof: The demonstration is run AT LEAST TWICE: once with the consuming process exiting successfully, and once with it exiting in failure. Removal is verified after each. The failure run must be a REAL failure of the consuming process, induced by making the consumer fail, not simulated by asserting what would happen.
items.what_does_NOT_count: A single successful run plus a reading of the teardown code. A failure run where the failure is injected AFTER removal, which exercises the success path wearing a failure label. Inferring the failure path from the presence of a teardown construct in the source.
items.derived_gap: The condition names two paths. A consuming process that is KILLED, or a session that terminates abruptly, is on NEITHER, and no teardown construct in the consumer runs at all. The authority's two-path text does not reach it. This artifact does NOT add a third path as a binding requirement, because adding a condition the authority does not carry is the error OF-DAG-3 exists to flag. It records the gap at OF-N05-4 and requires the demonstration to STATE the mechanism's behaviour under abrupt termination, as a statement rather than as a pass criterion.

items.must_be_proven: Absence after removal is asserted FROM A CHECK, and recorded as a BOOLEAN.
items.standard_of_proof: The absence check must be DEMONSTRATED CAPABLE OF RETURNING FALSE. The demonstration runs the SAME check once while the sentinel is deliberately still present, and it must report PRESENT; then after removal, and it must report ABSENT. Both results are recorded. A check exercised only on the path where it is expected to pass has proven nothing about itself.
items.what_does_NOT_count: A boolean recorded as true with no negative exercise of the check that produced it. Absence inferred from the fact that a removal command was issued, which the condition prohibits in terms. A check that reads a different scope from the one the value was set in, which returns absent for the wrong reason and is the most dangerous false pass available here.

items.must_be_proven: The consuming process's child-process topology is STATED, and for each child it is stated whether it retains, forwards or logs the environment.
items.standard_of_proof: An enumeration of the actual children observed during the demonstration, not a list of children the consumer is believed to spawn. Where the consumer spawns none, that is stated as a measured observation.
items.what_does_NOT_count: A statement that the consumer has no children, unaccompanied by an observation. An enumeration drawn from reading the consumer's source, which cannot see children spawned by libraries, tooling hooks or the runtime itself.
items.binding_status: This is a DERIVED obligation of N05 under the DAG, NOT a sixth condition. It is DISCHARGED BY STATEMENT. It does not, by itself, fire STOP_SECRET_DELIVERY_NONCOMPLIANT unless the statement reveals a child that retains, forwards or logs the value, in which case WCM-C1's own scope is breached and the token fires on that ground.
items.on_failure: Absence of the statement is an INCOMPLETE N05, not a compliant one. The node's exit condition names the statement explicitly.

items.must_be_proven: Whether the VAULT READ ITSELF is audited or logged, and WHERE.
items.standard_of_proof: A statement naming the audit surface if one exists, or stating that none was found and by what means that was checked. If an audit entry exists, the statement must say whether it records the ENTRY HANDLE, because a handle recorded in an audit trail is a custody question under SSL-06 that the evidence contract does not otherwise reach.
items.what_does_NOT_count: A statement that the value is not logged, which answers a different question. The absence of a log the demonstration never looked for.
items.binding_status: DERIVED obligation, DISCHARGED BY STATEMENT, exactly as RC-7.
items.on_failure: Absence of the statement is an INCOMPLETE N05.

READINESS_CONTRACT.EXIT_CONDITION_OF_N05_carried_verbatim_f: All five conditions demonstrated, the child-process topology stated, and the vault read's own logging behaviour stated.
READINESS_CONTRACT.THE_CONJUNCTION_IS_TOTAL: All eight items must hold. derived_properties_this_artifact_adds.why: Measured at ES-5. scan-secrets suppresses a PG_DSN_EMBEDDED_PASSWORD finding when the password component is under six characters or matches isUnmistakablePlaceholder, which is a union of a placeholder-literal pattern and a FIXTURE_MARKER pattern matching any value containing not-a-real, placeholder, example, sample, fake, synthetic, dummy, fixture or redacted. The obvious way to make a sentinel visibly non-real is to embed one of exactly those words, and doing so makes the repository's own gate stop seeing it.

A sentinel the repository's secret gate treats DIFFERENTLY from the real value is a stand-in that diverges from its subject at exactly the surface the programme uses to catch leaks, and the divergence runs in the unsafe direction: it makes the sentinel invisible to the one control that would catch a transcript landing in the tree.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: THE ACT THAT CHOOSES AND BUILDS THE VAULT-READ MECHANISM IS NOT A NODE OF THE CERTIFIED DAG. N05 demonstrates a CHOSEN mechanism; its sole precondition N03 is the OD-1..OD-6 ratification gate, which ratifies a custody store and a delivery class but selects no mechanism. All twenty-eight nodes were enumerated in this lane and none produces one.
OPEN_FINDINGS.why_it_is_blocking: N05 cannot be attempted at all. An execution lane reaching N05 has no subject to demonstrate, and an empty node is the kind that gets marked satisfied by default rather than failed honestly.
OPEN_FINDINGS.disposition: Recorded, and the missing lane is DERIVED at THE_SUBSEQUENT_IMPLEMENTATION_LANE without being opened. This artifact does NOT add a node to the certified DAG.
OPEN_FINDINGS.what_a_certifier_should_press: Whether the missing act should become a new DAG node by successor amendment, or whether it is correctly outside the DAG as an owner-plane or workstation-plane prerequisite the graph is entitled to presuppose. If the latter, press whether N05's precondition list should nonetheless name it, so that its absence is visible at the frontier rather than discovered on arrival.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: NO NODE OF THE CERTIFIED DAG DEPOSITS THE MINTED CREDENTIAL INTO THE CUSTODY STORE. N11 sets a fresh credential on the hosted management plane. N23 places the credential into the consuming process's environment BY THE N05-DEMONSTRATED MECHANISM, which is a vault READ. N12 updates the custody INVENTORY, which is a repository record of names and roles and expressly never a value. The value's path from the management plane into the Windows Credential Manager is performed by no node.
OPEN_FINDINGS.method: All twenty-eight node objects were serialized and searched in this lane. Exactly two mention a vault: N05, which names a vault-READ mechanism, and N06, which names the inventory. A targeted search for deposit, store-the-credential and place-into-the-vault phrasings across the whole artifact returned nothing.
OPEN_FINDINGS.why_it_matters_to_N05_specifically: A readiness demonstration for a READER is of bounded value if the corresponding WRITE is both unnoded and unconditioned. RC-3 records the sharper form: a vault-write performed by a command that carries the value as an argument would reintroduce the exact disclosure WCM-C2 exists to prevent, one step earlier in the chain and outside any node's conditions.
OPEN_FINDINGS.the_narrower_question_this_artifact_decl: Whether SECRET_DELIVERY_CONTRACT.ABSOLUTELY_PROHIBITED_MECHANISMS item 2, passing it as a command-line argument, BINDS the custody-deposit act. Read flatly it does, and the deposit would be constrained. Read in the scope of its parent clause, whose stated requirement is how the value reaches the EXECUTING PROCESS, it governs DELIVERY and the deposit is not delivery. This artifact does NOT resolve the ambiguity, because resolving it either way changes what a future lane may do and that is an adjudication, not a derivation.
OPEN_FINDINGS.disposition: Recorded. A successor amendment or an adjudication is named as needed at THE_SUBSEQUENT_IMPLEMENTATION_LANE.the_second_derived_lane_or_amendment. Neither is performed here.
OPEN_FINDINGS.what_a_certifier_should_press: Which reading of ABSOLUTELY_PROHIBITED_MECHANISMS item 2 is correct, and whether the custody deposit requires its own node, its own conditions and its own fail-closed placement before N23 can be reached.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: WCM-C3 IS A PROPERTY OF THE SESSION, NOT OF THE MECHANISM. The other four conditions are properties a mechanism can carry intrinsically. C3 is satisfied or failed by the session the mechanism is invoked from, so the same compliant mechanism passes from one session and fails from another.
OPEN_FINDINGS.why_it_matters: N05 requires a demonstration that THE MECHANISM satisfies all five. For C3 that can only mean the mechanism carries an enforced invocation contract. A demonstration that runs once in a clean session and reports C3 satisfied has proven a fact about that session and nothing about the mechanism, and the same evidence would be produced by a mechanism with no invocation contract at all.
OPEN_FINDINGS.disposition: RC-4 requires the demonstration to state HOW the session property is enforced at every future invocation, not merely that it held once. That requirement is DERIVED and is not in the authority's own words.
OPEN_FINDINGS.what_a_certifier_should_press: Whether requiring an enforcement statement is legitimate interpretation of what DEMONSTRATE THAT THE MECHANISM SATISFIES means for a session-scoped condition, or whether it attaches an obligation the five conditions do not contain, which is the same question OF-DAG-3 raises about the child-process obligation. Additionally, whether RC-4's requirement to enumerate history-persisting facilities BY NAME crosses from requirement interpretation into mechanism design, which this artifact is absolutely barred from.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: WCM-C4 NAMES TWO PATHS, SUCCESS AND FAILURE. A consuming process that is killed, or a session that terminates abruptly, is on neither, and no teardown construct in the consumer runs at all. The condition's text does not reach that case.
OPEN_FINDINGS.disposition: NO THIRD PATH IS ADDED AS A BINDING REQUIREMENT. RC-5 requires the demonstration to STATE the mechanism's behaviour under abrupt termination, as a statement and not as a pass criterion. Adding a condition the authority does not carry is precisely the error OF-DAG-3 exists to flag, and this artifact declines to commit it in a new place.
OPEN_FINDINGS.what_a_certifier_should_press: Whether abrupt termination is a genuine gap in MECHANISM_2's conditions requiring a successor amendment to SECRET_DELIVERY_CONTRACT, or whether it is adequately covered because a vault-backed mechanism that never persists the value outside the vault has nothing left behind to remove. If the latter, the statement RC-5 requires is exactly the evidence that settles it.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: AN IN-TREE DELIVERY PATTERN EXISTS AT EXACTLY THE FILENAME THE CONTRACT PROHIBITS. scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts writes the dot-env audit-local file inside the working tree, gitignored, for the disposable local PostgreSQL harness, and scripts/p1a-bootstrap-gate.ts references the same path. This is NOT a violation, because the prohibition binds the hosted auditor credential and these scripts write a local disposable one.
OPEN_FINDINGS.why_it_matters: It is the nearest existing pattern an implementer would find, it works, and reusing it for the hosted credential would breach ABSOLUTELY_PROHIBITED_MECHANISMS item 3 while looking like conformity to an established convention. A prohibition is weakest where a compliant-looking counterexample sits next to it.
OPEN_FINDINGS.disposition: Named explicitly in the readiness contract and in the derived lane's prohibitions, so the refusal does not depend on an implementer noticing the distinction unaided.
OPEN_FINDINGS.what_a_certifier_should_press: Whether the two credentials being written to one filename in one repository is itself worth separating by name, so that a future reader cannot conflate them at all.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: NEITHER THE DAG NOR THE CAPABILITY AUTHORITY STATES THE SENTINEL'S SHAPE, only that it is credential-shaped, non-functional and freshly generated. SP-1 adds that it must be shaped like the real value, which is a connection string carrying userinfo. SP-4 adds the sharper constraint that it must not be SUPPRESSED by the repository secret scanner.
OPEN_FINDINGS.why_it_matters: A sentinel of a different shape leaves the WCM-C2 command-line search and the WCM-C5 absence check hunting a pattern the real value does not have. The check then cannot fail for the right reason, which is the same defect as a check exercised only on its pass path.
OPEN_FINDINGS.the_sharper_half_at_SP_4: SENT-DAG-1's own words, fabricated and non-functional, point an implementer at exactly the construction the repository's scanner suppresses. Measured at ES-5: the FIXTURE_MARKER pattern treats any value containing not-a-real, placeholder, example, sample, fake, synthetic, dummy, fixture or redacted as unmistakably non-secret, and a password component under six characters is suppressed as well. The most natural reading of the authority's own sentinel description therefore produces a sentinel the repository's secret gate cannot see, which is a divergence from the real value at precisely the surface the programme relies on to catch a leak. SP-4 closes it by requiring the sentinel to be scanner-visible, which makes the gate treat sentinel and credential alike.
OPEN_FINDINGS.disposition: Carried as DERIVED properties of SENT-DAG-1, not as an amendment to it, and paired with SP-2 and SP-3 so that a scanner-visible sentinel can never land in the working tree. The combination is deliberate: SP-4 makes the sentinel visible to the gate, SP-2 and SP-3 keep it out of the gate's jurisdiction entirely.
OPEN_FINDINGS.what_a_certifier_should_press: Whether shape-matching is a derivation from credential-SHAPED or an addition to it; whether requiring the demonstration to run outside the working tree is a necessary consequence or an over-reach; and, on SP-4 specifically, whether requiring a sentinel to be INVISIBLE to the fixture-marker escape hatch conflicts with the scanner's own stated intent, which is to let a suite hold a credential-shaped literal provided the literal says so in its own body. If a certifier rules that the escape hatch is the correct route, SP-4 must be withdrawn and the N05 demonstration's sentinel becomes scanner-suppressed by design, in which case the contract must say so explicitly rather than leave it implied.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: NO CI RUNNER IN THE REPOSITORY CAN EXECUTE A BEHAVIOURAL N05 CONTROL. All nine runs-on values across all nine workflow files are ubuntu-latest; there is no Windows runner and no matrix. The subject of N05 is a Windows-only OS facility.
OPEN_FINDINGS.why_it_matters: It means the behavioural half of the N05 test contract is, at AS_OF_TREE, WORKSTATION-RECORDED AND NOT CI-GATED. Worse, the repository's established skipIf idiom would render such a control SKIPPED-AND-GREEN on the only runner that exists, which is indistinguishable from PASSED in a summary line.
OPEN_FINDINGS.disposition: The companion manifest splits the contract into a platform-independent half that CI can genuinely redden and a platform-dependent half that is workstation-recorded, and adds a mutation control whose whole purpose is to prove that a skipped platform control can never be reported as a pass. NO CI WORKFLOW IS ADDED OR MODIFIED BY THIS ARTIFACT.
OPEN_FINDINGS.what_a_certifier_should_press: Whether a workstation-recorded control is acceptable evidence for a hoisted precondition of an irreversible mutation, or whether N05 requires a Windows CI runner to exist first. If the latter, that is a further prerequisite of N05 and belongs in the derived lane's mandate.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: THIS ARTIFACT'S RE-DERIVATION OF THE MECHANISM ABSENCE RETURNED SIX FILES WHERE THE DAG RECORDED TWO, under the identical alternation. The substance is unchanged and the verdict survives, because the four additional matches are the governance artifacts written between the two trees.

Recording the reconciliation here is cheaper than letting it be rediscovered as an alarm. It also demonstrates the general hazard: an authority freezes a count against ITS tree, and the count, not the finding, is what goes stale.
OPEN_FINDINGS.disposition: Recorded at DOES_ANY_CURRENT_REPOSITORY_MECHANISM_SATISFY_THEM.method_1_exact_replication.reconciliation. NO correction to the DAG is made or requested; its verdict was and remains correct.
OPEN_FINDINGS.what_a_certifier_should_press: Whether the DAG's raw_result should be read as a measurement pinned to its own AS_OF_TREE, which is how this artifact reads it, or as a standing claim about the repository, which would make it now false.
